Titles.jpn: GTO

Summaries.eng: Tough on the outside, all heart on the inside, Onizuka turned to the life of a high school teacher for less excitement and action... or so he thought. GTO, a.k.a. Great Teacher Onizuka, is the racy story of Onizuka, a former motorcycle gang member who becomes a teacher to make a difference and... to meet girls? Using his street smarts to deal with colleagues, students and troublemakers, Onizuka finds that he too has many lessons to learn!
Summaries.jpn:
かつて最強の不良「鬼爆」の一人として湘南に君臨した鬼塚英吉は、辻堂高校を中退後、優羅志亜（ユーラシア）大学に替え玉試験で入学した。彼は持ち前の体力と度胸、純粋な一途さと若干の不純な動機で、教師を目指した。

無茶苦茶だが、目先の理屈よりも「ものの道理」を通そうとする鬼塚の行為に東京吉祥学苑理事長の桜井良子が目を付け、ある事情を隠して中等部の教員として採用する。学園内に蔓延する不正義や生徒内に淀むイジメの問題、そして何より体面や体裁に振り回され、臭いものに蓋をして見て見ぬ振りをしてしまう大人たち、それを信じられなくなって屈折してしまった子どもたち。この学園には様々な問題が山積していたのである。

桜井は、鬼塚が問題に真っ向からぶつかり、豪快な力技で解決してくれることに一縷の望みを託すようになる。

Titles.eng: Shonan Junai Gumi! 3 Runaway Angel of Hell

Titles.jpn: 鬼塚英吉22歳! 元不良 伝説の教育実習が今はじまる!!

Summaries.eng: Eikichi Onizuka begins his career as a teacher-in-training expecting that he will get a class of attractive, nubile high school girls. When he is assigned the problem "O class", a group of delinquents and blackmailers, only his tough love is able to win them over.

Titles.jpn: 天敵・内山田教頭登場!! 大逆転!?の最終面接

Summaries.eng: Eikichi applies at Holy Forest Academy, and conflicts with the school's vice principal, Hiroshi Uchiyamada. Disgusted by his condescending attitude, he leaves knowing that they never would have hired him anyway. However, the school's chairwoman Ryoko Sakurai, impressed by his character, decides to offer him a job.

Titles.jpn: 教師の仕事は命がけ?! 深夜の屋上ダイビング

Summaries.eng: The new school year gets off to a rocky start for Eikichi. He has to teach middle school instead of high school students, live in a storage area at school, and rescue a student, Noboru Yoshikawa, from suicide.

Titles.jpn: 攻撃開始! 今、あばかれる鬼塚の怪しい日常?!

Summaries.eng: Eikichi learns first-hand what tricks his homeroom students are capable of. Yoshito Kikuchi, a computer expert, releases fake images of Eikichi engaged in BDSM and homosexual acts. Instead of getting mad, Eikichi asks Yoshito if he can create nude celebrity pictures for him

Titles.eng: An Eye for an Eye, a Butt for a Butt
Titles.jpn: 悪魔のリベンジ!!　目には目を、お尻にはお尻を

Summaries.eng: Anko Uehara and her gang bullies Noboru for hanging out with Eikichi. After rescuing Noboru from suicide (again), Eikichi decides that revenge is the only way to teach Anko a lesson.

Titles.jpn: 失業確定? 抗議殺到、あいつをクビにしろ!!

Summaries.eng: Following Anko's "lesson", Eikichi must face the PTA for his actions. When it appears that Eikichi is fighting a losing battle, Yoshito and Noboru reveal Anko's true nature to the PTA.

Titles.jpn: 最も危険な家庭訪問! 母ちゃんに手を出すな

Summaries.eng: While preparing for parent-teacher meetings, Eikichi learns that one of his students, Kunio Murai, has a very young mother. He decides that "dates" are an excellent way to get to know the parents, much to Kunio's dismay.

Titles.jpn: 村井死す!? 決死のベイブリッジ・バンジー!

Summaries.eng: When Kunio and his friends are confronted by local punks, they believe they are saved when Eikichi arrives. However, he refuses to help, believing their predicament will teach them about taking responsibility. Faced with a bungee jump, Kunio proves how far he will go to prevent his mother from dating Eikichi.

Titles.eng: Onizuka and the Art of War
Titles.jpn: うなる筋肉! 激闘! 鬼塚VS熱血体育教師!

Summaries.eng: Eikichi goes head-to-head with the P.E. teacher Hajime Fukuroda. Meanwhile, Miyabi Aizawa enlists her friend Tomoko Nomura to frame Eikichi as an underwear thief. When she accidentally incriminates Mr. Fukuroda instead, Miyabi berates Tomoko for her stupidity.

Titles.jpn: 私ぬぎます! 朋子14歳・体当たりの初体験!

Summaries.eng: Tomoko is depressed that Miyabi no longer wants her as a friend. Eikichi tries to cheer Tomoko up and enters her into a beauty contest to help her out with her self-esteem.

Titles.eng: To Be Idolized by a Nation
Titles.jpn: ゆれるFカップ! ビッグな胸とアイドル伝説!

Summaries.eng: At the talent beauty contest, Tomoko's clumsiness makes her a long shot to win, but discovers that being herself is her special talent. Despite losing, she gains newfound respect from her classmates.

Titles.jpn: 鬼塚追放! 闇の策略!

Summaries.eng: Suguru Teshigawara, the math teacher, has his heart set only on Azusa Fuyutsuki; however, Eikichi inadvertently incurs Suguru's wrath when he ruins Suguru's plans to win Azusa over.

Titles.jpn: 鬼塚またまた失業確定?!

Summaries.eng: Suguru enlists a parent lobby group to get Eikichi fired. To prove his worth, Eikichi must score the highest mark in a national scholastic achievement test. However, he soon learns that it is no easy task.

Titles.eng: Between a Rock and a Hard Place
Titles.jpn: 地獄? 夢の二人暮らし

Summaries.eng: Determined to prevent his dismissal, Azusa invites Eikichi to her place for one-on-one all-night study sessions. Meanwhile, believing that studying alone isn't enough to get the highest mark, Eikichi's students attempt to steal the test answers from the school.

Titles.jpn: 死闘! 血染めの解答用紙!

Summaries.eng: On the day of the test, Eikichi witnesses the abduction of a Diet member's daughter and pursues the kidnappers to an abandoned warehouse. During the ensuing brawl, Eikichi rescues the daughter, but is shot in the process. He manages to return to the school, but has to write the day-long test in one hour.

Titles.jpn: 鬼塚マジギレ!! 強敵出現!!

Summaries.eng: Eikichi relishes his newfound hero status until he meets Urumi Kanzaki, a mischievous girl who gets him arrested as a pervert. He is less than amused when he finds out that she is actually one of his students.

Titles.jpn: 悪い夢! 逃亡者・鬼塚!

Summaries.eng: Eikichi learns that Urumi went through a traumatic childhood experience and tries to help her cope with it using his own brand of teaching. His efforts unfortunately backfire when he accidentally pushes her off a building.

Titles.jpn: 再会・恩師よ……

Summaries.eng: Blackmailed by Urumi for pushing her off a building, Eikichi subjects himself to her whims. After meeting her former elementary teacher, Urumi goes on a classroom terrorism spree.

Titles.jpn: 鬼塚、命がけの課外授業

Summaries.eng: Urumi's teacher admits that she was the cause of Urumi's mistrust towards teachers. When Urumi was younger, she accidentally revealed the secret about Urumi's father. Eikichi decides that only a special lesson across an incomplete freeway will teach Urumi about life.

Titles.jpn: Fからのラブレター

Summaries.eng: Kunio finds a love letter addressed to him, initially believing it is from Akane Fujita, a girl he likes. However, when Akane dumps him, Kunio realizes his true feelings for his platonic friend, Fuyumi Kujirakawa.

Titles.jpn: 教師失格? 消えた冬月

Summaries.eng: Unable to cope with the pressures of teaching, Azusa runs away to her former school in Hakuba. Eikichi, Tomoko, Yoshito, and Kunio follow in order to convince her to return.

Titles.jpn: 鬼塚爆死?! 炎の大脱出!!

Summaries.eng: Azusa learns that her former school will be demolished. During the countdown, a former student of the school runs into the building to retrieve a precious heirloom. Eikichi pursues in order to rescue her before the school is destroyed.

Titles.jpn: 鬼塚死す!? 最後の七日間

Summaries.eng: Eikichi receives a cursed chain letter, but he dismisses it as superstition. After a series of misfortunes, he begins to believe in the letter and does whatever he can to dispel the curse.

Titles.jpn: 父焦る! 家の娘に限って!!

Summaries.eng: Mr. Uchiyamada experiences a mid-life crisis, wondering if there is any meaning left to his life. His family has grown apart and now fears for the worst when his daughter Yoshiko takes a liking to Eikichi.

Titles.jpn: お色気先生に鬼塚クラッ

Summaries.eng: An attractive school nurse, Nao Kadena, arrives at the school, much to the delight of Eikichi. However, she soon starts using her looks and the school to fund her money-making schemes.

Titles.jpn: 湘南の鬼VSハコスカの女王

Summaries.eng: Eikichi learns that Nao, a former street racer, was using the school to help pay her brother's medical costs for an accident that she blames herself for. Eikichi challenges her to a game of no signals to teach her about self-worth.

Titles.jpn: トロ子の芸能界虎の穴

Summaries.eng: Eikichi becomes Tomoko's manager and arranges a series of innocuous commercial shoots to increase her national profile. Her commercials attract the attention of a popular magazine who wants her entered into their beauty contest.

Titles.eng: Whatever Can Go Wrong, Will Go Wrong
Titles.jpn: 発表! 21世紀新アイドル

Summaries.eng: From getting bōsōzoku gangs to vote for Tomoko to questionable marketing ploys, Eikichi does whatever he can to make sure that Tomoko will win the contest. However, a contemptuous rival competitor undermines his efforts.

Titles.jpn: セーラー服と112万円

Summaries.eng: Before the annual class field trip, Miyabi and her friends steal the school's trip money and blackmails the English teacher, Mr. Sakurada, into luring Eikichi to a fake "underground girls club" with the stolen money planted on him. At the club, a drunken Eikichi unwittingly spends the school's money.

Titles.jpn: 罪と罰! 横領犯・鬼塚?!

Summaries.eng: Led to believe that he spent the school's money, Eikichi attempts to raise the money himself while his students investigate who set him up. The school's faculty decides to hold a student assembly so Eikichi can take responsibility for his actions.

Titles.jpn: 目指せ!! 憧れの沖縄行路

Summaries.eng: Framed as an embezzler, Eikichi promises to make it up to all of the 3rd year students with a trip to Okinawa. He claims that he can pay for it with a winning lottery ticket, but when he finds out that the ticket was a fraud, he has to find another way to pay for the ¥8 million trip.

Titles.jpn: 嗚呼ベンツ丸つぶれ

Summaries.eng: Eikichi wins a Mercedes-Benz E-class sedan in a local contest, worth enough to pay for the trip. Unfazed, Miyabi arranges for a suicidal salaryman to jump in front of Eikichi's car and ruin his chances of selling it.

Titles.jpn: さらば鬼塚・22才の別れ

Summaries.eng: To teach Miyabi and her friends a lesson, Urumi orchestrates their kidnapping to hold them for ransom. Eikichi literally flies in to save the day and foils Urumi's plans.

Titles.jpn: 監獄に一番近い警官

Summaries.eng: When Tomoko, Eikichi, and his friend Toshiyuki Saejima find a suitcase filled with gold, they find themselves on the run from the yakuza. However, they later discover that they were unlikely victims of a celebrity prank played on Tomoko.

Titles.jpn: 花嫁は14歳!! の息子あり

Summaries.eng: When Kunio finds a wedding dress catalog at home, he suspects his mother will marry someone behind his back. Overprotective of his mother, Kunio will stop at nothing to stop her wedding.

Titles.jpn: 冬月変身! 燃えろ夏女!

Summaries.eng: Nao helps Azusa choose a bathing suit for the trip to Okinawa. Asuza tries to get a makeover in order to impress Eikichi, but ends up getting carried away in the process.

Titles.jpn: 嵐の予感! 沖縄でGo!

Summaries.eng: To make it a trip to remember, Eikichi assigns his students to co-ed rooms. Noboru is perplexed with Eikichi's decision to assign him with Anko and her friends. Eikichi helps Noboru make the most of a bad situation with a good old-fashioned prank on the girls.

Titles.jpn: 突撃! 宝探しでGo!

Summaries.eng: Eikichi learns of a hidden treasure somewhere on one of Okinawa's islands and decides that a special class trip is in order. During the expedition, Anko and her friends tie up Noboru to leave him in the jungle, but end up getting lost in the process.

Titles.jpn: 二人の冒険!! 秘密の洞窟

Summaries.eng: Separated, Anko and Noboru are forced to find their way to safety together. Eikichi, however, believes their disappearance was a ruse to conceal their discovery of the treasure, and searches for them in hot pursuit.

Titles.jpn: ハート直撃!! 沖縄純愛組

Summaries.eng: Following her ordeal, Anko is conflicted over the new emotions that she feels for Noboru. To teach Anko to be true to her heart, Eikichi plans a special nighttime lesson for the class.

Titles.jpn: 青春少女!! 初めての告白

Summaries.eng: Eikichi orders his class to walk through a derelict hotel as a test of nerves. Anko and Noboru make it past Eikichi's test, but when confronted by four local hooligans, Anko stands up for Noboru against the bullies and confesses her feelings towards him.

Titles.jpn: ラストバトル! 蘇る傷跡

Summaries.eng: Miyabi confronts Noboru Saitou, the class's former teacher, about the incident that drove them to hate teachers. When Mr. Saitou is later found stabbed, suspicion immediately falls on Miyabi.

Titles.jpn: 挫! 愚零徒出夜露死苦!

Summaries.eng: Miyabi's friends and teachers work to protect her from the corrupt teacher's union whose pressure on Mr. Saitou over his unprofessional relationship drove his student lover to suicide. Eikichi decides to take the blame for the stabbing to clear Miyabi of any wrongdoing.
